name: Regold (Veteran)
subjectPrompt: Regold Durril, a living human veteran in his early thirties from gothic Barovia, tired guarded face and short dark-brown windswept hair, with faint stubble. Simple heavy wool layered clothing, faded green-taupe faded winter coat over worn linen, sturdy mud-toned boots and a travel belt. Longsword hanging sheathed at the hip with the hilts visible and a shorter sword tucked into the belt. Quiet, wary stance, visible bare face, no heavy armor or helmet. A soldier off duty, tense in the shoulders.

name: The Visitor
subjectPrompt: The Visitor in the human guise described in the adventure: a refined, unsettling Barovian visitor with neatly brushed dark hair and an eerily self-possessed expression. Elegant blackish brown fitted doublet over a subtle muted plum waistcoat, rings set with small ruby and emerald stones, fine worn pale-gray silk cape trimmed in coarse black fur, fraying at its lower edge. Holding a compact spellbook made of thin brass plates threaded on a thick brass ring. Slight stale dust swirl at the foot of the cape only, authoritative posture. He looks fully human, without horns, wings, or tail.
